about: The user: the Rainbow Bridge's left (south-west) end was too tight to pass ('push some assets away a bit'). The painted crowd at the south foot (the big parasol's crowd, the pack donkey heading into it, the long-robed men watching the boat) closed the bank between the ramp's near railing and the mat sheds: no way round the railing's end, the crowd's south edge shut at the pack donkey's rump (0.79 m to its driver), and the one gap onto the bank under the arch 1.05 m between the parasol crowd and the long-robed men (gen/interact/passes/bridge_before.txt). Three figures move 0.3-0.5 m within their groups so one lane of at least 1.2 m runs from the foot round the crowd's south edge onto the bank under the arch (bridge_after.txt).

S3.fig.man_dark_cap_18812.why: bridge pass: the way from the south foot onto the bank under the arch squeezed through 1.05 m between him and the long-robed man seen from behind (long_robe_back_18806); 0.3 m north, still behind the crowd below the big parasol's east rim (foot est in the map), the gap 1.3 m

S3.fig.stout_man_18750.why: bridge pass: the same gap's south-west side (1.17 m to long_robe_back_18806); 0.18 m north-west, still in the middle of the crowd below the big parasol, the gap 1.3 m

S3.fig.donkey_walker_18481.why: bridge pass: the crowd's south edge was shut at the pack donkey's rump (donkey_sack_18535): 0.79 m between its rump and him; 0.5 m south, still behind the rump driving it (painted striding just west of it), the gap 1.3 m
